title: Gentle Jaw-Muscle Work
summary: Small gentle circles are applied over the muscular cheek near the masseter.
goal: Gently relax superficial tissues around the jaw.
startingPosition: The jaw is relaxed and the teeth are not clenched.
instructions: Ask the person to relax the jaw.
Place the fingers over the soft cheek tissue.
Do not press on the joint.
direction: Small circles over the muscular cheek tissue.
warning: Do not massage damaged or inflamed skin. Stop with dizziness, worsening headache, pain, or other unusual symptoms.
